ADHD freelancer diary: I avoided one 20 minute task for 9 days and almost lost my biggest client.

I'm not lazy. I knew exactly what to do. I just couldn't start.

1. The task: send the final logo files
2. 9 days of opening the folder and closing it
3. The "just checking in" email that made my stomach drop
4. I said the task out loud and did only step 1: open the client folder

Sent at 12:40. The whole thing took 18 minutes.

Save this for your next stuck day, and send it to the freelancer friend who gets it.

💜 The app I use is FOCO, link in bio.

blocks.text: adhd freelancer diary
yesterday i came *dangerously* close to losing my biggest client
one task. send the final logo files. 20 minutes, tops.
i'd been avoiding it for *9 days.*
9am. opened the folder. closed it. made coffee. cleaned my desk.
11am. *still* not sent.
my fake productive era
then this landed in my inbox:
"hey! just checking in on those files? we launch friday 🙂"
my stomach dropped.
i'm not *lazy.*
i know exactly what to do. i just can't start.
if you know, you know
so i opened FOCO and just said it out loud.
one tap, and it broke it into *tiny* steps.
step 1. that's all i had to do.
*sent* at 12:40.
the whole thing took 18 minutes. 9 days of dread for 18 minutes.
i could actually cry
you don't need another *to-do list.*
you need help starting 💜
same? 👇
